description: This file defines a final class UnmodifiableExternalMessageBuilder that implements ExternalMessageBuilder. It provides methods to construct and modify ExternalMessage instances, including setting headers, payloads, authorization, topic, enforcement, and internal headers. It acts as a builder for ExternalMessage objects within the org.eclipse.ditto.services.models.connectivity package.

classes.name: UnmodifiableExternalMessageBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for creating instances of ExternalMessage with mutable configuration options before building an immutable ExternalMessage.

methods.description: Constructor initializing builder with an existing ExternalMessage.

methods.name: UnmodifiableExternalMessageBuilder
methods.description: Constructor initializing builder with a headers map.
